## Overview

This document (Part 2) builds on the cleaned data from Part 1 to compare
molecular changes across the **9-month** and **15-month** timepoints.
We examine temporal concordance, pathway progression, gene-level trajectories,
and produce an integrated summary of the Rps2-A226Y mutant liver phenotype.

## Libraries & Data Loading

```{r}
#| label: load-libraries
#| echo: true

# Load core packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(pals)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(gprofiler2)
```

All cleaned data comes from Part 1 outputs. This ensures reproducibility and
avoids redundant data processing.

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| echo: true

# Load cleaned datasets from Script 1 output
input_dir <- here("output", "01_data_loading_and_pathway_analysis")

met_9m  <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "met_9m_clean.rds"))
met_15m <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "met_15m_clean.rds"))
tx_9m   <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "tx_9m_clean.rds"))
tx_15m  <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "tx_15m_clean.rds"))

pw_summary_9m  <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "pw_summary_9m.rds"))
pw_summary_15m <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "pw_summary_15m.rds"))
pathway_map    <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "pathway_map.rds"))

cat("Data loaded successfully from:", input_dir, "\n")
```

## Temporal Merging

We inner-join metabolites and genes by name across timepoints to create paired
datasets. This lets us compute correlation statistics and identify features
that are consistently or differentially regulated across ages.

```{r}
#| label: merge-metabolites
#| echo: true

# Merge metabolites across timepoints by biochemical name
met_merged <- met_9m %>%
  dplyr::select(biochemical, sub_pathway, super_pathway,
                log2fc_9m = log2fc, pval_9m = p_value) %>%
  inner_join(
    met_15m %>%
      dplyr::select(biochemical, log2fc_15m = log2fc, pval_15m = p_value),
    by = "biochemical"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_cat = case_when(
      pval_9m < 0.05 & pval_15m < 0.05 ~ "Both",
      pval_9m < 0.05                   ~ "9m only",
      pval_15m < 0.05                  ~ "15m only",
      TRUE                             ~ "Neither"
    )
  )

cat("Common metabolites:", nrow(met_merged), "\n")
count(met_merged, sig_cat) %>% knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: merge-genes
#| echo: true

# Merge genes across timepoints by gene name
tx_merged <- tx_9m %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, log2fc_9m = log2fc, pval_9m = p_value, fdr_9m = fdr) %>%
  inner_join(
    tx_15m %>%
      dplyr::select(gene_name, log2fc_15m = log2fc, pval_15m = p_value, fdr_15m = fdr),
    by = "gene_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_cat = case_when(
      fdr_9m < 0.05 & fdr_15m < 0.05 ~ "Both",
      fdr_9m < 0.05                  ~ "9m only",
      fdr_15m < 0.05                 ~ "15m only",
      TRUE                           ~ "Neither"
    )
  )

cat("Common genes:", nrow(tx_merged), "\n")
count(tx_merged, sig_cat) %>% knitr::kable()
```

### Correlation Analysis

Strong positive correlation between timepoints indicates a persistent and
progressive phenotype rather than a transient response.

```{r}
#| label: correlations
#| echo: true

# Pearson and Spearman correlations for both omics layers
cor_met_pearson  <- cor.test(met_merged$log2fc_9m, met_merged$log2fc_15m,
                             method = "pearson")
cor_met_spearman <- cor.test(met_merged$log2fc_9m, met_merged$log2fc_15m,
                             method = "spearman")
cor_tx_pearson   <- cor.test(tx_merged$log2fc_9m, tx_merged$log2fc_15m,
                             method = "pearson")
cor_tx_spearman  <- cor.test(tx_merged$log2fc_9m, tx_merged$log2fc_15m,
                             method = "spearman")

tibble(
  Omics = c("Metabolome", "Metabolome", "Transcriptome", "Transcriptome"),
  Method = rep(c("Pearson", "Spearman"), 2),
  r = c(cor_met_pearson$estimate, cor_met_spearman$estimate,
        cor_tx_pearson$estimate, cor_tx_spearman$estimate),
  p_value = c(cor_met_pearson$p.value, cor_met_spearman$p.value,
              cor_tx_pearson$p.value, cor_tx_spearman$p.value)
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Temporal fold-change correlations (9m vs 15m)",
               digits = 4)
```

## Figure 6: Temporal Scatter Plots

Scatter plots of 9m vs 15m fold changes for both metabolites and genes. Points
are coloured by significance category. The identity line (dashed) indicates
equal fold change at both ages.

```{r}
#| label: fig-temporal-scatter
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6.5

# Colour palette for significance categories
sig_colors <- c(Both = "#e7298a", `9m only` = "#66a61e",
                `15m only` = "#7570b3", Neither = "#cccccc")
sig_order  <- c("Neither", "9m only", "15m only", "Both")

# Panel A: Metabolome scatter
p_met_scatter <- met_merged %>%
  mutate(sig_cat = factor(sig_cat, levels = sig_order)) %>%
  arrange(sig_cat) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2fc_9m, y = log2fc_15m, color = sig_cat)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = sig_cat, size = sig_cat)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Label top metabolites significant at both timepoints
  geom_text_repel(
    data = . %>% filter(sig_cat == "Both") %>%
      slice_max(abs(log2fc_15m), n = 8),
    aes(label = biochemical), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 15,
    segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors, name = "Significant at") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(Neither = 0.15, `9m only` = 0.7,
                                `15m only` = 0.7, Both = 0.85),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(Neither = 0.8, `9m only` = 1.8,
                               `15m only` = 1.8, Both = 2.2),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Metabolome (n = ", nrow(met_merged), ")"),
    subtitle = sprintf("r = %.3f, \u03c1 = %.3f",
                       cor_met_pearson$estimate, cor_met_spearman$estimate),
    x = expression(log[2] * "FC at 9 Months"),
    y = expression(log[2] * "FC at 15 Months")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Panel B: Transcriptome scatter
p_tx_scatter <- tx_merged %>%
  mutate(sig_cat = factor(sig_cat, levels = sig_order)) %>%
  arrange(sig_cat) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2fc_9m, y = log2fc_15m, color = sig_cat)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = sig_cat, size = sig_cat)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors, name = "Significant at") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(Neither = 0.05, `9m only` = 0.5,
                                `15m only` = 0.15, Both = 0.8),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(Neither = 0.3, `9m only` = 1,
                               `15m only` = 1, Both = 1.8),
                    guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-1, 1) * max(abs(c(tx_merged$log2fc_9m,
                                tx_merged$log2fc_15m))) * 0.5,
    ylim = c(-1, 1) * max(abs(c(tx_merged$log2fc_9m,
                                tx_merged$log2fc_15m))) * 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Transcriptome (n = ", nrow(tx_merged), ")"),
    subtitle = sprintf("r = %.3f, \u03c1 = %.3f",
                       cor_tx_pearson$estimate, cor_tx_spearman$estimate),
    x = expression(log[2] * "FC at 9 Months"),
    y = expression(log[2] * "FC at 15 Months")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Combine panels
p_temporal_scatter <- p_met_scatter + p_tx_scatter +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Temporal Concordance of Fold Changes: 9 vs 15 Months",
    subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_temporal_scatter
```

## Figure 7: Temporal Pathway Comparison

Paired horizontal bar charts showing mean log2 FC of significant features at
9m vs 15m, faceted by omics layer. This highlights the escalation (or
resolution) of pathway dysregulation over time.
 
```{r}
#| label: fig-temporal-pathway
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7

# Combine pathway summaries with timepoint labels
pw_combined <- bind_rows(
  pw_summary_9m  %>% mutate(timepoint = "9 Months"),
  pw_summary_15m %>% mutate(timepoint = "15 Months")
)

# Reshape for plotting
pw_plot <- pw_combined %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_gene_log2fc, mean_met_log2fc),
    names_to = "omics", values_to = "mean_log2fc"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    omics_label = if_else(omics == "mean_gene_log2fc",
                          "Transcriptome (FDR < 0.05)",
                          "Metabolome (p < 0.05)"),
    n_sig = if_else(omics == "mean_gene_log2fc", n_genes_sig, n_met_sig),
    n_found = if_else(omics == "mean_gene_log2fc", n_genes_found, n_met_found),
    pathway = fct_rev(fct_inorder(pathway)),
    direction = case_when(
      mean_log2fc > 0 ~ "Up",
      mean_log2fc < 0 ~ "Down",
      TRUE            ~ "None"
    )
  )

p_temporal_pathway <- ggplot(
  pw_plot,
  aes(x = mean_log2fc, y = pathway, fill = direction, alpha = timepoint)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  # Annotation labels showing n significant
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("n=", n_sig),
        hjust = if_else(mean_log2fc >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Up = "#d95f02", Down = "#1b9e77", None = "#999999"),
    name = "Direction"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("9 Months" = 0.5, "15 Months" = 0.85),
    name = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ omics_label, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal Progression of Pathway Dysregulation: 9 vs 15 Months",
    subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver, female mice",
    x = expression("Mean " * log[2] * " Fold Change"),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_temporal_pathway
```

## g:Profiler Enrichment Analysis

We use g:Profiler to query KEGG and Reactome pathway databases for enrichment
among genes significant at each timepoint.

```{r}
#| label: gprofiler-enrichment
#| echo: true

# Extract significant gene lists (filtering date-corrupted names)
sig_genes_9m <- tx_9m %>%
  filter(significant, is.character(gene_name)) %>%
  pull(gene_name)

sig_genes_15m <- tx_15m %>%
  filter(significant, is.character(gene_name)) %>%
  pull(gene_name)

cat("Significant genes — 9m:", length(sig_genes_9m),
    "| 15m:", length(sig_genes_15m), "\n")

# Run g:Profiler for KEGG and Reactome
enrich_9m <- gost(
  query = sig_genes_9m,
  organism = "mmusculus",
  sources = c("KEGG", "REAC"),
  significant = TRUE,
  user_threshold = 0.05
)

enrich_15m <- gost(
  query = sig_genes_15m,
  organism = "mmusculus",
  sources = c("KEGG", "REAC"),
  significant = TRUE,
  user_threshold = 0.05
)

cat("Enriched terms — 9m:", nrow(enrich_9m$result),
    "| 15m:", nrow(enrich_15m$result), "\n")
```

## Figure 8: Enrichment Comparison Dot Plot

We compare significantly enriched KEGG/Reactome terms across timepoints.
Each dot's size reflects the number of overlapping genes, and position shows
the −log10 adjusted p-value.

```{r}
#| label: fig-enrichment-comparison
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9

# Extract and merge enrichment results
enrich_9m_df <- enrich_9m$result %>%
  dplyr::select(term_name, source, p_value, intersection_size, term_size) %>%
  rename(pval_9m = p_value, n_genes_9m = intersection_size)

enrich_15m_df <- enrich_15m$result %>%
  dplyr::select(term_name, source, p_value, intersection_size, term_size) %>%
  rename(pval_15m = p_value, n_genes_15m = intersection_size)

# Full outer join on term name
enrich_compare <- full_join(enrich_9m_df, enrich_15m_df,
                            by = c("term_name", "source", "term_size")) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10p_9m  = -log10(pmax(pval_9m, 1e-20)),
    neg_log10p_15m = -log10(pmax(pval_15m, 1e-20))
  ) %>%
  replace_na(list(neg_log10p_9m = 0, neg_log10p_15m = 0,
                  n_genes_9m = 0, n_genes_15m = 0)) %>%
  # Keep terms with at least moderate significance at one timepoint
  filter(neg_log10p_9m > 1.3 | neg_log10p_15m > 1.3) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log10p_15m)) %>%
  head(25)

# Reshape for dot plot
enrich_plot <- enrich_compare %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(neg_log10p_9m, neg_log10p_15m),
    names_to = "timepoint_var", values_to = "neg_log10p"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = if_else(timepoint_var == "neg_log10p_9m",
                        "9 Months", "15 Months"),
    n_genes = if_else(timepoint_var == "neg_log10p_9m",
                      n_genes_9m, n_genes_15m),
    term_name = fct_reorder(term_name, neg_log10p, .fun = max)
  )

p_enrichment <- ggplot(enrich_plot,
       aes(x = neg_log10p, y = term_name,
           size = n_genes, color = timepoint)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), color = "red",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("9 Months" = "#66a61e",
                                "15 Months" = "#7570b3"),
                     name = "Timepoint") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "Gene count") +
  labs(
    title = "g:Profiler Pathway Enrichment: 9m vs 15m Comparison",
    subtitle = "KEGG + Reactome, FDR < 0.05",
    x = expression(-log[10] * "(adjusted p-value)"),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_enrichment
```

## Figure 9: Key Metabolite Trajectories (9m → 15m)

Slope chart showing fold-change trajectories for selected metabolites from
bile acid, glutathione, and lipid pathways. Open circles = 9m, filled = 15m.
Lines connect the same metabolite across timepoints.

```{r}
#| label: fig-metabolite-trajectory
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# Define key metabolites for trajectory analysis
key_metabolites <- tribble(
  ~biochemical_lower,                           ~pathway_group,
  "taurocholate",                               "Bile Acid",
  "cholate",                                    "Bile Acid",
  "taurochenodeoxycholate",                     "Bile Acid",
  "glycocholate",                               "Bile Acid",
  "tauro-beta-muricholate",                     "Bile Acid",
  "taurodeoxycholate",                          "Bile Acid",
  "deoxycholate",                               "Bile Acid",
  "taurolithocholate 3-sulfate",                "Bile Acid",
  "ophthalmate",                                "Glutathione",
  "glutathione, reduced (gsh)",                 "Glutathione",
  "glutathione, oxidized (gssg)",               "Glutathione",
  "cysteinylglycine",                           "Glutathione",
  "s-methylglutathione",                        "Glutathione",
  "sphingomyelin (d18:1/18:0, d18:0/18:1)*",   "Lipid",
  "sphingomyelin (d18:2/16:0, d18:1/16:1)*",   "Lipid",
  "palmitoyl sphingomyelin (d18:1/16:0)",       "Lipid",
)

# Match against merged data (case-insensitive)
traj_data <- met_merged %>%
  mutate(biochemical_lower = tolower(biochemical)) %>%
  inner_join(key_metabolites, by = "biochemical_lower") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_either = pval_9m < 0.05 | pval_15m < 0.05,
    label = if_else(nchar(biochemical) > 25,
                    paste0(substr(biochemical, 1, 22), "..."),
                    biochemical)
  )

cat("Found", nrow(traj_data), "metabolites for trajectory plot\n")

# Pathway colour palette
pw_colors <- c("Bile Acid" = "#e7298a", "Glutathione" = "#66a61e",
               "Lipid" = "#7570b3")

p_trajectory <- ggplot(traj_data) +
  # Lines connecting 9m to 15m
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = 1, y = log2fc_9m, yend = log2fc_15m,
        color = pathway_group, linewidth = sig_either, alpha = sig_either)
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 2, `FALSE` = 0.7), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 0.85, `FALSE` = 0.3), guide = "none") +
  # 9m points (open circles)
  geom_point(
    aes(x = 0, y = log2fc_9m, color = pathway_group),
    shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  # 15m points (filled circles)
  geom_point(
    aes(x = 1, y = log2fc_15m, color = pathway_group),
    shape = 19, size = 3
  ) +
  # Labels for significant metabolites at 15m
  geom_text_repel(
    data = traj_data %>% filter(pval_15m < 0.05 | pval_9m < 0.05),
    aes(x = 1.05, y = log2fc_15m, label = label, color = pathway_group),
    size = 2.8, hjust = 0, direction = "y", nudge_x = 0.02,
    segment.color = "grey70", segment.size = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("9 Months", "15 Months"),
    limits = c(-0.1, 1.7)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pw_colors, name = "Pathway") +
  labs(
    title = "Key Metabolite Trajectories: 9 \u2192 15 Months",
    subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver",
    y = expression(log[2] * " Fold Change (Mutant / WT)"),
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

p_trajectory
```

## Directionality Consistency

A key question is whether features significant at both timepoints maintain
the same direction of change, and whether the effect amplifies at 15 months.

```{r}
#| label: directionality
#| echo: true

# Genes significant at both timepoints
genes_both <- tx_merged %>% filter(sig_cat == "Both")
gene_same_dir <- genes_both %>%
  mutate(same_dir = sign(log2fc_9m) == sign(log2fc_15m))

cat("Genes significant at both timepoints:", nrow(genes_both), "\n")
cat("  Same direction:", sum(gene_same_dir$same_dir),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", mean(gene_same_dir$same_dir) * 100))
cat("  Amplified at 15m:",
    sum(abs(genes_both$log2fc_15m) > abs(genes_both$log2fc_9m)),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n",
            mean(abs(genes_both$log2fc_15m) > abs(genes_both$log2fc_9m)) * 100))

# Metabolites significant at both timepoints
mets_both <- met_merged %>% filter(sig_cat == "Both")
met_same_dir <- mets_both %>%
  mutate(same_dir = sign(log2fc_9m) == sign(log2fc_15m))

cat("\nMetabolites significant at both timepoints:", nrow(mets_both), "\n")
cat("  Same direction:", sum(met_same_dir$same_dir),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", mean(met_same_dir$same_dir) * 100))
cat("  Amplified at 15m:",
    sum(abs(mets_both$log2fc_15m) > abs(mets_both$log2fc_9m)),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n",
            mean(abs(mets_both$log2fc_15m) > abs(mets_both$log2fc_9m)) * 100))
```

```{r}
#| label: direction-switching-metabolites
#| echo: true

# Identify metabolites that switched direction between timepoints
met_same_dir %>%
  filter(!same_dir) %>%
  dplyr::select(biochemical, log2fc_9m, log2fc_15m, pval_9m, pval_15m) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Metabolites with opposite direction at 9m vs 15m",
               digits = 4)
```

### Gene-Level Detail: Key Pathway Genes

```{r}
#| label: key-gene-detail
#| echo: true

# Check specific ISR/UPR, lipogenesis, and antioxidant genes across timepoints
key_genes <- c(
  # ISR / UPR
  "Hspa5", "Hsp90b1", "Atf4", "Atf3", "Atf6", "Ddit3",
  "Eif2ak3", "Xbp1", "Ern1", "Asns",
  # Lipogenesis
  "Srebf1", "Srebf2", "Fasn", "Acaca", "Scd1", "Scd2", "Ppara",
  # Antioxidant
  "Gpx1", "Gpx3", "Gpx4", "Gsr", "Gsta1", "Gsta2",
  "Gstm1", "Gstm2", "Gstm3", "Nqo1", "Sod1", "Sod2", "Cat"
)

tx_merged %>%
  filter(tolower(gene_name) %in% tolower(key_genes)) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_9m  = if_else(fdr_9m < 0.05, "*", ""),
    sig_15m = if_else(fdr_15m < 0.05, "*", ""),
    group = case_when(
      tolower(gene_name) %in% tolower(c("Hspa5", "Hsp90b1", "Atf4", "Atf3",
                                         "Atf6", "Ddit3", "Eif2ak3", "Xbp1",
                                         "Ern1", "Asns")) ~ "ISR / UPR",
      tolower(gene_name) %in% tolower(c("Srebf1", "Srebf2", "Fasn", "Acaca",
                                         "Scd1", "Scd2", "Ppara")) ~ "Lipogenesis",
      TRUE ~ "Antioxidant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, gene_name) %>%
  dplyr::select(Group = group, Gene = gene_name,
                `log2FC 9m` = log2fc_9m, `FDR 9m` = fdr_9m, ` ` = sig_9m,
                `log2FC 15m` = log2fc_15m, `FDR 15m` = fdr_15m, `  ` = sig_15m) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Key pathway gene changes (* = FDR < 0.05)",
               digits = 4)
```

## Figure 10: Integrated Pathway Heatmap

A summary heatmap showing mean log2 FC of significant features across all six
pathways, four data slices (transcriptome/metabolome × 9m/15m).

```{r}
#| label: fig-integrated-heatmap
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Build heatmap data: mean log2FC per pathway × omics × timepoint
heatmap_data <- pw_summary_9m %>%
  transmute(pathway,
            `Tx 9m`  = mean_gene_log2fc,
            `Met 9m` = mean_met_log2fc) %>%
  left_join(
    pw_summary_15m %>%
      transmute(pathway,
                `Tx 15m`  = mean_gene_log2fc,
                `Met 15m` = mean_met_log2fc),
    by = "pathway"
  )

# Also store n significant for cell annotations
n_data <- pw_summary_9m %>%
  transmute(pathway,
            `Tx 9m`  = n_genes_sig,
            `Met 9m` = n_met_sig) %>%
  left_join(
    pw_summary_15m %>%
      transmute(pathway,
                `Tx 15m`  = n_genes_sig,
                `Met 15m` = n_met_sig),
    by = "pathway"
  )

# Use ggplot2 tile heatmap (avoids ComplexHeatmap Bioconductor dependency)
heatmap_long <- heatmap_data %>%
  pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "data_slice", values_to = "mean_log2fc") %>%
  left_join(
    n_data %>%
      pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "data_slice", values_to = "n_sig"),
    by = c("pathway", "data_slice")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    data_slice = factor(data_slice,
                        levels = c("Tx 9m", "Met 9m", "Tx 15m", "Met 15m")),
    pathway = fct_rev(fct_inorder(pathway)),
    cell_label = sprintf("%.2f\n(n=%d)", mean_log2fc, n_sig)
  )

# Determine symmetric colour limits
vmax <- max(abs(heatmap_long$mean_log2fc))

p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_long,
       aes(x = data_slice, y = pathway, fill = mean_log2fc)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_label),
            size = 3, color = if_else(abs(heatmap_long$mean_log2fc) > vmax * 0.5,
                                      "white", "black")) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-vmax, vmax),
    name = expression("Mean " * log[2] * "FC")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Integrated Pathway Summary: 9 vs 15 Months",
    subtitle = "Rps2-A226Y Mutant vs WT, Liver (significant features only)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_heatmap
```

## Final Summary

```{r}
#| label: final-summary
#| echo: true

cat("=" , strrep("=", 58), "\n")
cat("INTEGRATED ANALYSIS SUMMARY\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

cat("--- Dataset Sizes ---\n")
cat(sprintf("9m transcriptome:  %d genes, %d significant (FDR < 0.05)\n",
            nrow(tx_9m), sum(tx_9m$significant)))
cat(sprintf("15m transcriptome: %d genes, %d significant (FDR < 0.05)\n",
            nrow(tx_15m), sum(tx_15m$significant)))
cat(sprintf("9m metabolome:     %d metabolites, %d significant (p < 0.05)\n",
            nrow(met_9m), sum(met_9m$significant)))
cat(sprintf("15m metabolome:    %d metabolites, %d significant (p < 0.05)\n",
            nrow(met_15m), sum(met_15m$significant)))

cat("\n--- Temporal Concordance ---\n")
cat(sprintf("Genes sig at both:       %d, %.0f%% same direction\n",
            nrow(genes_both), mean(gene_same_dir$same_dir) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Metabolites sig at both: %d, %.0f%% same direction\n",
            nrow(mets_both), mean(met_same_dir$same_dir) * 100))

cat("\n--- Key Biological Findings ---\n")
cat("1. Progressive phenotype: 9m -> 15m shows escalating dysregulation\n")
cat("2. Bile acid accumulation enriched at BOTH timepoints\n")
cat("3. ISR/UPR: Hspa5/BiP up at 9m, silenced at 15m\n")
cat("4. Lipogenesis suppressed at 15m (Srebf1, Fasn, Acaca)\n")
cat("5. Antioxidant downregulation at 15m (Gpx1, Sod1)\n")
```
